boms: select b.{{id:boms}} as id, b.name, b.product_category__label as category, b.total_cogs, b.target_margin, (select p.name from associations a join products p on p.pc_0021_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'products' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}} order by p.name limit 1) as product, (select p.msrp from associations a join products p on p.pc_0021_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'products' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}} order by p.name limit 1) as msrp, (select p.gsa_price from associations a join products p on p.pc_0021_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'products' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}} order by p.name limit 1) as gsa_price, (select sum(coalesce(l.quantity, 0) * coalesce(l.unit_cost, 0)) from associations a join lines l on l.pc_0020_id = a.other_record_id where a.object = 'boms' and a.other_object = 'lines' and a.record_id = b.{{id:boms}}) as lines_cost from boms b order by b.name
